newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS - GASOLINE UP, GAS OIL DOWN.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS - GASOLINE UP, GAS OIL DOWN.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday with gasoline a gainer, gas oil losing and fuel oil steady to a touch firmer.
Gasoline gained $1-2 a tonne on the back of a draw in U.S. gasoline stocks. Several barges traded at the higher levels.

Gas oil eased 75 cents in line with September IPE which was at $170.00 at 1144 GMT. Heating oil barge spreads were steady at around screen flat or just under, but business was inactive with some traders concentrating on the logistics of the IPE expiry.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were steady to firmer, at $96.26 fob ARA on swaps up to $1 higher and bunker demand.
Russian cracked cargoes were offered steady but straight-run, in plentiful supply and with little buying interest seen, was offered a little weaker at two means +$3 for M-100.
